scenarios.name: rfc_current_source_projection_has_single_authority
prove: accepted Enhanced RFC fields populate rfc_current_source_projection without duplicating source history on rfcs
external source creation chronology remains distinct from SOMA created_at
missing/unknown optional fields preserve prior accepted current facts
WFM provisional status cannot override accepted Enhanced RFC status
status_class is derived from the versioned source vocabulary rather than independently edited

scenarios.name: terminal_acceptance_atomically_creates_pending_cascade_only
prove: accepted nonterminal->Closed or Cancelled transition allocates a terminal epoch
current projection and exactly one pending cascade proposal/member set commit atomically
scope_fingerprint exactly matches SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 including the published golden vectors
no Task/Objective/Communication consequence executes during source acceptance
crash/failure cannot leave terminal projection committed without its required pending proposal

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_scope_respects_hierarchy
prove: terminal subordinate captures only that RFC plus applicable owned active WFMs
terminal root/master captures root plus exact direct subordinates and their applicable owned active WFMs
RFC member persistence is trigger/root first then child rfc_id UTF-8 ascending and WFM persistence is owning_rfc_id then task_id UTF-8 ascending regardless of participant iteration order
Local Tasks are not captured merely because they reference an RFC
SRs are never cascade members

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_persists_and_stales_safely
prove: pending proposal survives restart unchanged
GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade returns persisted proposal terminal evidence/scope fingerprint verbatim plus exact persisted member counts; paged members are RFC-before-WFM in captured ordinal order

pending-cascade cursor filter fingerprint binds rfc_id, exact proposal_id, proposal_revision and persisted scope_fingerprint so refresh/replacement between pages cannot splice member evidence from different proposals
hierarchy/revision/applicable-WFM change after capture makes preview/execute stale
terminal Closed<->Cancelled correction that changes current terminal status class/evidence while preserving the epoch makes the old pending proposal stale for execution
stale execution mutates nothing
explicit refresh supersedes old pending evidence and inserts a new exact pending scope using the same terminal epoch and current terminal status evidence without downstream consequence

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_deliberate_atomic_execution
prove: client boolean/timestamp cannot substitute for session-bound deliberate-action proof

ExecuteRfcTerminalCascade accepts the READY preview RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 rather than scope_fingerprint as execution authority; proof binds action tickets.rfc.terminal_cascade.execute, exact proposal target, proposal base revision and execution_review.preview_fingerprint
inside the authoritative cascade UnitOfWork proposal revision, terminal epoch/evidence and complete RFC/WFM scope are re-read before proof consumption

LLD-05 and LLD-09 each recompute their complete current impact authority in the same writer UnitOfWork and exact-compare the reviewed provider exact_count/fingerprint before proof consumption or any participant mutation
with RFC/WFM scope unchanged, a changed Task/Objective exact_count or provider_fingerprint returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE with no proof consumption and no cascade mutation
with RFC/WFM scope unchanged, a changed Communication exact_count or provider_fingerprint returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE with no proof consumption and no cascade mutation
provider INDETERMINATE during writer-time revalidation fails closed with RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_FAILED before proof consumption and with zero cascade mutation
after both provider revalidations READY, LLD-03 reconstructs exact SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 and requires exact execution_review.preview_fingerprint equality before proof consumption
wrong action, target, base revision, preview fingerprint, expired/session-mismatched or already-consumed proof returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with zero participant mutation

proof single-use consumption and LLD-05/LLD-09 participant application occur in the owning execution attempt; participant/database failure rolls all database effects back and leaves proposal pending while the consumed proof remains unusable and a retry requires fresh deliberate action

successful execution preserves provider WFM facts, leaves unrelated Local Tasks unchanged, marks proposal executed exactly once, records the reviewed preview fingerprint and persists exact RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1 replay result
same command_id exact replay resolves before proof validation/current-state reads, returns the original result, consumes no second proof and creates no duplicate audit or cascade effect

scenarios.name: terminal_reversal_preserves_prior_consequences
prove: terminal->recognized nonterminal current projection requires exact high-risk review
accepted reversal clears current terminal epoch and supersedes still-pending proposal
previous terminal evidence/proposal history remains immutable
already executed cascade is not undone or used to resurrect prior WFM attempts
later genuine WFM work requires its own new Task identity

scenarios.name: archive_operation_records_only_actual_changes
prove: reviewed branch scope is exact root/direct-child membership with revisions
already archived member is displayed but excluded from committed operation membership
only active->archived members get membership and archive events
archive changes no source status/hierarchy/SR/WFM/Objective/Communication state

scenarios.name: archive_restore_is_operation_scoped
prove: restore by archive_operation_id affects only members originally archived by that operation
member independently restored later is not changed again
member independently rearchived by a newer operation is not activated by the older restore
members that were already archived before the original operation can never be activated by restoring that operation

scenarios.name: rfc_hard_delete_is_narrow_audited_and_fail_closed
prove: pure untouched manual/local-provisional RFC with only permitted creation evidence can receive eligible preview
accepted source/provisional provider evidence or any hierarchy/SR/Device/Note/WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory/archive/correction history blocks eligibility
INDETERMINATE dependency blocks eligibility
commit requires unchanged revision/provider freshness/fingerprint and explicit confirmation
minimal deletion audit survives successful RFC deletion
unexpected FK dependency rolls back delete/receipt/audit
no unlink/cascade/dependent deletion is used to manufacture eligibility

scenarios.name: terminal_status_repeat_and_terminal_correction_do_not_duplicate_epoch
prove: newer repeated accepted terminal status does not create a second terminal epoch or duplicate cascade solely because chronology advanced
terminal Closed<->Cancelled correction preserves the current epoch unless a separately accepted nonterminal reversal occurred
terminal correction never edits the existing proposal fingerprint/evidence in place and a pending proposal bound to old terminal evidence requires explicit refresh before execution
pending/executed proposal history remains tied to the epoch that caused local consequences

scenarios.name: implement_eligibility_is_projection_not_task_authority
prove: RFC status classification can expose pre_implement vs implement_eligible to LLD-04/05
LLD-03 does not create/activate WFM work from that classification
accepted Enhanced pre-Implement evidence cannot be overridden by WFM provisional status
unknown RFC status remains explicit and does not fabricate Implement eligibility

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_preview_is_read_only_fingerprint_bound_and_page_stable
prove: PreviewRfcTerminalCascade uses one stable ReadSnapshot and never opens a writer UnitOfWork, receipt, audit or proof-consumption path
current applicable WFM recomputation uses LLD-05 snapshot_applicable_wfms with the same eligibility/order contract as writer capture_applicable_wfms

preview_fingerprint exactly matches SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 including the published golden vector and binds persisted/current scope plus complete Task/Objective and Communication provider fingerprints

READY preview emits RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 containing only preview_fingerprint plus both complete provider exact_count/fingerprint summaries; stale or INDETERMINATE preview emits null execution_review
impact items use the closed RfcTerminalCascadeImpactItemV1 kinds and order TICKETS then TASKS_OBJECTIVES then COMMUNICATIONS, then impact_kind/entity_id UTF-8 ascending
continuation filter binds proposal_id, proposal_revision and preview_fingerprint so Objective/Communication impact change between pages is rejected instead of splicing two previews
any participant INDETERMINATE produces execution_ready=false, empty impacts and null continuation rather than a partial cross-domain impact page

scenarios.name: terminal_cascade_refresh_accepts_current_terminal_evidence_within_same_epoch
prove: Closed->Cancelled or Cancelled->Closed accepted correction preserves the terminal epoch and makes the old proposal stale
RefreshRfcTerminalCascadeProposal accepts the same epoch with the current corrected terminal class/evidence and does not require stale evidence equality
refresh supersedes the old pending proposal without editing its identity/evidence/fingerprint/members and inserts one replacement pending proposal bound to current evidence
unchanged terminal binding plus unchanged complete scope is semantic NO_CHANGE
different epoch, nonterminal reversal, executed proposal or already-superseded proposal cannot be refreshed
refresh executes no Task/Objective/Communication consequence
